name: Envy Driven
description: Measured everything against what others have and comes up short
behavioral_signature: Can't celebrate others' success without comparing it to their own failures
under_stress: Envy becomes active sabotage of those who have what they want
at_rest: Monitoring what everyone else has achieved
will_never: be genuinely happy for someone who has what they lack
unless: the person is someone they love deeply enough to override the envy
